items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: Mingus? Like “Fables of Faubus.” ... Mingus making fun of the horrible racist governors at the time. ... Shostakovich and Mingus. I think that’s the first two names that come to mind

ctx.x: It’s something I came across today made me think that next January 6 will be the fifth anniversary of the attack on Congress. And I don't know why my mind went – because I was listening to your music and I was thinking if someone commissioned you to write a work to mark that anniversary, would you accept it, and where would you start?

Oh boy. Wow. I think I would accept it but it would be a difficult job. It would be a lot of I don't know what it would come out sounding like. Irony? Like Shostakovich type mocking of stupidity you know? Mingus? Like “Fables of Faubus.” That’s the first thing that comes to mind. Shostakovich making fun of the Stalin ass-kissing generals and Mingus making fun of the horrible racist governors at the time. There’d be plenty you could come up with between – I’m trying to think who or what else? But that’s plenty.…
would like, maybe I’d be off and running. But it would be a difficult job, also depending on how –
